Changes.note: Pressing “Kayıt başvurusu yap” on a locked celse creates your enrollment in this course: where the course requires approval it waits as a request, which the course team sees and approves or rejects; otherwise you hold a seat at once. You can withdraw the request or leave the course from its page. If you already have an enrollment, nothing changes. While a ban stands, the application is refused.
